items.title: David Tepper Bought CoreWeave Before It Fell 51%. Is He Wrong, or Early?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoreWeave is down 51% since June 30, the quarter-end of the 13F in which David Tepper’s Appaloosa first reported owning it. It’s the worst of Appaloosa’s buys from that quarter: Meta is up 14% since then, Uber is down 3%, and Taiwan Semiconductor and Boeing are down 17% and 20%.

items.title: Northrop Grumman (NOC) Will Not Protest Its F A XX Loss
items.summary: Northrop Grumman (NYSE:NOC) has chosen not to protest the U.S. Navy's F/A-XX fighter award to Boeing. The decision follows the Navy's selection of Boeing for the next-generation carrier-based fighter contract, a flagship combat aircraft program. By forgoing a protest, Northrop Grumman leaves the current F/A-XX award structure in place without seeking a formal review process.
